We can update the billing entity and remit instructions, and we do support VAT split handling for EU-registered entities. To proceed we need the following from your side:

- Signed legal name change confirmation on company letterhead or a registration extract (PDF)
- VAT certificate (looks like you already attached it — thank you)
- New wiring instructions / bank details (IBAN, SWIFT) and preferred remit email

Estimated timeline: once we have the docs, internal finance + legal signoff usually takes 2–4 business days. Marcus, Laura — can you confirm whether we need special tax-team review for the VAT split routing?
